channel.title: Katoya Palmer
channel.description: Essays, recipes, reviews and the weekly letter Thought, Taste & Presence, from Katoya Palmer.

item.title: Crock Pot Pot Roast with French Onion Soup
item.description: Katoya Palmer's crock pot pot roast: browned chuck, French onion soup mix, fresh jalapeño and a Cajun base, smothered low and slow for 12 to 15 hours.

item.description: Katoya Palmer's homemade cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soups. Make them ahead, freeze them, and skip the can this Thanksgiving.

item.title: Cajun Potato Soup
item.description: Katoya Palmer's slow-cooker Cajun potato soup with andouille, bacon and jalapeño, no butter or flour, inspired by @ralphthebaker.

item.title: Game-Day Fried Chicken
item.description: Katoya Palmer's game-day fried chicken: Nature's Seasons and Cajun seasoning, buttermilk powder in the flour, a paper bag toss and jalapeños in the oil.

item.title: Lattice Apple Pie
item.description: A lattice apple pie with a stovetop filling of Honeycrisp and Granny Smith apples, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla, under a buttery hand-woven lattice.

item.title: Deviled Eggs
item.description: Katoya Palmer's game-day deviled eggs: eggs, mayo, mustard, relish and chives, seasoned to taste and topped with bacon, green onion or jalapeños.

item.title: Primo's, Bellevue: 4 lip prints
item.description: Primo's in Bellevue: chicken and waffles, a house salad wrapped like a bouquet, Taco Tuesday and live music. Four lip prints. Swoon. Bring a date worth it.

item.title: Kitchen-Extras Soup + Cream of Mushroom
item.description: A creamy soup built from Thanksgiving prep extras: homemade cream of mushroom, broth, roasted chicken, celery, carrots and onion. Plus the cream of mushroom.

item.title: Cajun Pesto
item.description: Cajun pesto from fresh basil: basil, Cajun seasoning, garlic, lemon, toasted pecans and pine nuts, parmesan and olive oil. Perfect for pasta, chicken, seafood or vegetables.

item.title: Split Pea Soup
item.description: Slow cooker split pea soup with ham (or smoked turkey), carrot, celery, onion, thyme, Cajun seasoning and a bay leaf. Cooked to taste, freezes well for fall.
